title: Tweety gets third degree in final Coyote vs. Acme trailer
excerpt: After years of being shelved, Coyote vs. Acme finally debuts its final trailer at SDCC, acquired by Ketchup Entertainment for a theatrical release. The event also featured a fresh Resident Evil adaptation from Zach Cregger, screening its first 18 minutes. Both releases highlight key trends in animation technology, data-driven distribution, and franchise revival.
